data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject only if the test is re-executed against the mutation after the guard is installed. The 3-of-26 result and the 1-of-9 compile.py loss are artifacts of the shown-to-fail-first installation terminating before the re-execution step: the test was shown failing, the guard was installed, but the test was never run again against the mutation, so the mutation was recorded as lost when in fact the guard would have caught it.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the harness demonstrably re-runs all tests against all mutations after every installation, the skipped-re-run mechanism is false.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3 surviving mutations are re-run manually after installation and still survive, the loss is not a termination artifact.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If compile.py's lost mutation is shown to be caught by a re-run, the loss was an installation-order artifact and not a coverage gap.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If an ordinarily-guarded module at 4/4 is shown to have the same re-run skip as a shown-to-fail module at 6/7, the installation mode does not explain the spread.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The shown-to-fail-first ritual has a temporal asymmetry. The test is run against the mutation before the guard exists, producing a failure. The guard is then installed. If the harness does not re-run the test against the mutation after installation, the mutation is never given the chance to be caught by the now-installed guard. The loss is not a property of the test or the guard but of the installation sequence's termination condition. The 3-of-26 survivors are mutations where the post-installation re-run was skipped, and the 1-of-9 compile.py loss is the same skip at compiler scale. The 4/4 to 6/7 spread in ordinarily-guarded modules reflects variance in whether the re-run step was executed, not a difference in guard quality.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
